Act: one surface, one question panel, one human release point; PACCAR systems decide claims.

working_rules: Branch, then pull request. Never push to main.
A change is done when GitHub shows the commit, not when an AI says so.
Leave a trail: commit message and PR description say what changed and why.
Public repositories hold schema, rules, names and states. Dealer rows and figures stay private or in Hawkins Azure.
One rooftop group per surface. Every twin MCP call names its scope.
Humans decide bookings; PACCAR systems decide claims.
